title: Two Octa-Nuclear {Ln8} (Ln = Tb, Dy) Complexes with "4 + 4" Covalent Organic Macrocycles: Structure, Solution Behavior, Luminescence, and Magnetic Properties

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: octanuclear terbium(III) covalent organic macrocycle with a 4+4 Schiff-base ligand

material_class.structural_family: Ln8 templated 4+4 Schiff-base covalent organic macrocycle

synthesis.procedure: Tb8L4+4 was synthesized by an in situ condensation/coordination reaction of one equivalent 2-hydroxy-5-methylisophthalaldehyde, one equivalent 1,3-diaminopropan-2-ol, two equivalents Tb(OAc)3, and two equivalents triethylamine under solvothermal conditions in methanol/acetonitrile, giving an octanuclear Tb8 cluster templated by a 4+4 Schiff-base macrocycle with 16 coordinated acetate anions.

reagents.name: 2-hydroxy-5-methylisophthalaldehyde
reagents.role: organic subcomponent for in situ 4+4 Schiff-base macrocycle

reagents.name: 1,3-diaminopropan-2-ol
reagents.role: organic subcomponent for in situ 4+4 Schiff-base macrocycle

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals of isostructural monoclinic P21/c Tb8L4+4 were obtained from the solvothermal assembly; isolation/work-up quantities are not given in the main text.

properties.summary: Solid-state luminescence of Tb8L4+4 is not obvious. In water, addition of dipicolinic acid (DPA) turns on typical Tb(III) 5D4→7F6–3 emission and enables selective, fast fluorescence sensing of DPA via a proposed Tb–DPA antenna effect.

measurements.name: Tb(III) emission maxima after DPA addition
measurements.conditions: aqueous Tb8L4+4 with DPA; 5D4→7F6–3 transitions; visible under UV lamp

measurements.name: DPA fluorescence detection limit (3σ/K)
measurements.conditions: turn-on sensing; linear fit y = 7.060 + 9.203x over 0.01–35 μM DPA; 10 μM Tb8L4+4

measurements.name: luminescence response time
measurements.value: maximum intensity reached in 10 s and stable for the next 50 s
measurements.conditions: aqueous Tb8L4+4 upon dropping DPA; intensity relatively stable at pH 1.0–12.0

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: octanuclear dysprosium(III) covalent organic macrocycle with a 4+4 Schiff-base ligand

material_class.structural_family: Ln8 templated 4+4 Schiff-base covalent organic macrocycle

synthesis.procedure: Dy8L4+4 is isostructural with Tb8L4+4 and was obtained analogously by in situ reaction of one equivalent 2-hydroxy-5-methylisophthalaldehyde, one equivalent 1,3-diaminopropan-2-ol, two equivalents Dy(OAc)3, and two equivalents triethylamine under solvothermal methanol/acetonitrile conditions, templating an octanuclear Dy8 cluster inside a 4+4 Schiff-base macrocycle.

reagents.name: 2-hydroxy-5-methylisophthalaldehyde
reagents.role: organic subcomponent for in situ 4+4 Schiff-base macrocycle

reagents.name: 1,3-diaminopropan-2-ol
reagents.role: organic subcomponent for in situ 4+4 Schiff-base macrocycle

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isostructural crystals in monoclinic space group P21/c; detailed isolation quantities are not given in the main text.

properties.summary: Dy8L4+4 shows χmT below the eight-ion Dy(III) free-ion value at 300 K, a low-temperature upturn assigned to ferromagnetic Dy···Dy interactions, magnetic anisotropy from non-superimposable M vs H/T plots, and zero-field single-molecule magnet behavior with slow magnetic relaxation.

measurements.name: χmT
measurements.conditions: 300 K; compared with 113.36 cm3 K mol-1 calculated for eight uncoupled Dy(III) ions (6H15/2)

measurements.name: χmT temperature dependence
measurements.value: decreases from 300 to 22 K, then slightly increases from 22 to 2 K
measurements.conditions: dc susceptibility; low-T upturn assigned to ferromagnetic Dy–Dy interaction

measurements.name: magnetization vs field
measurements.value: rapid rise at low field then flattening at high field; M vs H/T curves do not overlap

measurements.name: effective energy barrier Ueff
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of ln(τ) vs T−1; zero dc field ac susceptibility; SMM/SMR

measurements.name: Cole–Cole α parameter
measurements.conditions: general Debye model fit of Cole–Cole plots (Table S9)
